content:
[S] high | top header bar | "Copilot" title at top-center is clipped by the AF avatar chip on its left and collides with the Close/Copilot buttons on its right — three clusters crowd the same strip with no breathing room
[L] high | header row (y≈25) | the "Closed" label, black Copilot pill, and circular icon overlap the header text area; "Copilot" panel title at top-right is truncated/cut behind the panel close X and Local badge
[C] high | right copilot panel | panel is crammed with unrelated stacks (Signals, Summary, past-conversations note, suggested reply, CTA button) with no grouping separators, reading like a debug dump of features
[C] high | bottom-left dead zone | conversation list column is ~70% empty white space below two rows while the reading pane and copilot panel are crushed, an unbalanced composition
[H] high | middle properties card | status/state/priority segmented button rows all render at equal weight; nothing signals which controls are metadata vs actions, and 13+ same-styled chip buttons create heavy visual noise
[S] med | properties card | row labels (Status, Assignee, Priority, State, Tags, Snooze) sit at inconsistent vertical gaps — Tags row is tight against State while Snooze floats far below
[H] med | conversation list rows | sender name, ID/subject line, italic "Unassigned", and date all near-equal weight; subject (#501) should dominate but reads same as metadata
[S] med | suggested reply card | purple-tinted card left edge misaligns with the Signals/Summary cards above it and overhangs the panel's right margin differently than the white cards
[L] med | right panel header | "Copilot" title overlaps/collides with the sparkle icon and the "Local" chip; title text is partially obscured
[S] med | composer strip | composer spans only the reading column while the reply hint text ("reply — sent to the customer…") and Send button hug inconsistent insets — hint nearly touches bottom edge
[H] med | summary card | bullet list mixes customer quotes and system paraphrase at identical weight/size with no differentiation; last bullet repeats verbatim from the summary above it
[S] low | toolbar row | search input, "#" chip, "Apply" button, "Filters/Reset/Sync now" cluster use three different button heights and radii on one line
[H] low | status chips row | "AF" avatar fragment floats at top-left of the header next to clipped "#501" title, orphaned from its context
[C] low | divider "2026-10-16" | full-width hairline date divider in reading pane is inconsistently inset versus the message card below it

VERDICT: unprofessional — the header collisions, dead left column, debug-dump right panel, and chip-noise middle card read as a feature demo, not shippable helpdesk software.
